title: Actuator Type Matcher
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Actuators for Robotics
description: Read a comparison of three families of actuator, the hobby servo, the serial bus servo and the brushless CAN actuator, and then match eight short descriptions to the family each one fits. Used in Chapter 5.

educational.topic: Hobby servos, serial bus servos and brushless CAN actuators
learningObjectives: Classify eight descriptions of an actuator as a hobby servo, a serial bus servo or a brushless CAN actuator, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Read a comparison table, then place each new description into a family by one distinguishing feature
keyQuestions: Which family cannot tell your program where it is?
Which two features separate a serial bus servo from a brushless CAN actuator?
commonMisconceptions: All servos are controlled by a pulse width
A bus servo and a CAN actuator are the same thing
A hobby servo reports its position
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed choices, one attempt each; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Hobby servo / Serial bus servo / Brushless CAN actuator
